title: Patched
description: Not running vulnerable or malicious code: what patched finds on this Mac.

list.name: product
list.label: Product
list.description: Drill down: the per-advisory table in the Detail row shows these products. Empty with names off.

panels.title: Install now: is there something we need to be installing?
To install
panels.description: Items in use with an advisory that a release fixes: install it (Install now, below, says which version). Known exploited, in red, is how many of them carry a KEV advisory. Unknown means the OSV stage failed or no scan has run: never read it as nothing to do. Unused kegs are not counted: their action is evict (Unused copies).

defaults.noValue: Unknown: no scan data (see Scan stages failing)

panels.title: Names
panels.description: Whether this board names what to install. Names off is the default (counts only, so a shared Prometheus never holds names): Install now and the Detail row are then EMPTY, and empty does not mean nothing to install: read To install. With names off the list is in the scan record, ~/.patched/scans (patched scan prints it). To show it here, set PATCHED_DETAIL_SERIES=1 (patched scan --detail; for the schedule, set it and run patched schedule on again).

defaults.noValue: Names off: the list is in ~/.patched/scans. To show it here, set PATCHED_DETAIL_SERIES=1 (patched scan --detail; for the schedule, set it and run patched schedule on again)

0.text: Names off: the list is in ~/.patched/scans. To show it here, set PATCHED_DETAIL_SERIES=1 (patched scan --detail; for the schedule, set it and run patched schedule on again)

panels.title: Fixed upstream, no release
panels.description: Items in use with an advisory fixed upstream in a commit but in no release yet: nothing to install today, watch for the release. Not no fix. Unknown: the OSV stage failed.

panels.title: Brew already patched
panels.description: Items in use with an advisory the installed brew formula already patched (a backported fix): not exposed, nothing to do. Keyed on patched_by_brew, never on patch. Unknown: the OSV or brew_patches stage failed.

panels.title: No fix known
panels.description: Items in use with an advisory that no release, commit or brew patch fixes: mitigate, evict, or accept with an expiry. Unknown: the OSV stage failed.

panels.title: Install now
panels.description: One row per item in use that a release fixes: install the version in install and every advisory in the row clears (the HIGHEST fixed version they need). A newer release: the updater says outdated but OSV names no fixed version, so a newer one exists; it is not proof that it fixes them. Empty means nothing to install OR names off: read To install and Names. Click a product for its advisories.

defaults.noValue: Empty: nothing to install, OR names off. Read To install and Names.

latest.text: a newer release (OSV names no version)

panels.title: Exposed, by product (counts)
panels.description: Counts first: one row per item in use (product and installed version) with its advisories by what to do. install a release: install the version in install, which clears them all. fixed upstream, no release: wait for it. brew patched: nothing to do. no fix known: mitigate, evict or accept. Empty with names off. Click a product for its advisories.

defaults.noValue: Empty: names off, or nothing exposed in use. Read To install and Names.

latest.text: a newer release (OSV names no version)

panels.title: Patched alerts, firing and pending (Prometheus)
panels.description: Rules in $(brew --prefix)/etc/prometheus-rules/patched.rules.yml. With an Alertmanager, the severity label routes each alert.

panels.title: Known exploited
panels.description: In use and on CISA's KEV list: the fast path, patch now. Unused kegs are counted in the table, not here.

panels.title: Exposed, no patch
panels.description: No patch is not safe: mitigate, evict, or accept with an expiry.

panels.title: Listening beyond loopback
panels.description: Listeners on any address, a specific address, or a loopback port that tailscale serve or funnel publishes.

panels.title: Blind spots
panels.description: Installed items OSV can't vouch for: empty (OSV holds nothing), blind (records, but no version match), no_key. A zero from these is not clean.

panels.title: Last scan
panels.description: Age of patched.prom. node_exporter keeps serving a dead collector's file, so old means unknown, not safe.

panels.title: Installed, outdated and unmatched, by source
Listeners not on the allow list
panels.description: Listeners beyond loopback that the services allow list does not name. Until a list loads (patched_allowlist_loaded), every one counts.

panels.title: Installed, not allowed
panels.description: Installed top-level products that no allow file names: the Brewfile and apps files in the allow config's fleet, class and host layers (~/.patched/config). A dependency counts with its parent, not alone. If the list did not load, every product counts; PatchedAllowlistNotLoaded says so. No data means the products stage failed or has not run: see Scan stages failing. Names: patched allow check, or the detail row below.

panels.title: Exposed and listening
panels.description: Exposed items whose program is listening, by bind: any or address (beyond loopback), served (loopback, published by tailscale serve), loopback. All but loopback alert at once.

panels.title: Unused copies: evict
panels.description: Copies installed but not in use (old kegs). Names: patched scan --detail, local only.

panels.title: Scan stages failing
panels.description: A failed stage means its numbers are missing, not zero.

panels.title: Detail: names (empty unless patched runs with --detail)
Exposed advisories, by product
panels.description: One row per advisory. Filter with Product at the top (All by default); the Install now tables link here. fix: what to do (release, commit, brew, none; brew is keyed on patched_by_brew, never on patch); patch is the raw label.

release.text: Install a release (patch is the version)

commit.text: Fixed upstream in a commit, no release yet

panels.title: Installed, not allowed, by name
panels.description: One row per product that no allow file names. Empty unless patched runs with --detail. Allow one: add its line to a Brewfile (or apps) in the allow config (~/.patched/config).
